text: Job Description Overview The Landscape Architect I will support multidisciplinary teams in the planning, design, analysis, and delivery of projects ranging from public realm improvements, streetscapes, parks, campuses, transit-oriented developments, mixed-use districts, new towns, and large-scale masterplans to strategic infrastructure and regional planning projects. The role requires strong design thinking, analytical capability, digital proficiency, and the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple disciplines and geographies. Your role Contribute to projects across all design stages, from visioning, feasibility, concept development and master planning through to detailed design and implementation support. Take ownership of work and design under the supervision of Senior Landscape Architects & Urban Designers. Work on a program for the project and proactively advise Senior team members of any issue which affects the efficient completion of the project. Set out / agree design standards and parameters with senior team members. Responsible for completion of specifically assigned tasks to time and cost. Willing to undertake and be part of interdisciplinary technical co-ordination. Participate in internal design reviews, workshops, and interdisciplinary coordination meetings. The individual will be required to travel if required, at times to the different AtkinsRéalis offices and sites globally and interface with the team based there. Assist in preparing design studies, reports, presentations, technical documentation, and client deliverables. Undertake site analysis, precedent studies, benchmarking, and contextual research. Support the production of high-quality graphics, diagrams, visualizations, reports, and presentation materials. Understand the project workflow and assess for any possible enhancements & integration of new software & automation. Assist to achieve design & workflow innovation within the scope of projects. Assist in developing innovative, sustainable and resilient design solutions aligned with project objectives. Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English. Capable of working on own initiative or as part of a larger multidisciplinary team. Have a logical and organized approach to project delivery and able to follow instructions and guidance by senior team members. Able to identify and communicate concerns of the project/team to immediate Line Manager. Able to discuss career goals and aspirations. Having the ability to structure & work on independent subject research will be considered an additional advantage. Willingness to share information and knowledge with team members. About You A Master’s degree in Landscape Architecture from universities of National or International repute is a must. Bachelor’s degree holders in Landscape Architecture or Architecture will be considered, if they can showcase relevant experience in Landscape Design Project Stages. Including Design, Documentation and site implementation. Chartered or candidates on Pathway shall be considered the same being an added advantage. Experience level of 2-5 years required for the Landscape Architect I Must have relevant experience delivering Landscape and Public Realm projects. Should be able to explain the projects over all & their specific involvement. Experience in global market regions will be considered an additional advantage. Experienced candidates are expected to share both Work & Academic portfolios. Must be competent in design detailing and construction techniques. Must be conversant of the evolving standards of the profession primarily with respective to collaborative and multi-disciplinary design. All candidates must be able to self-classify their key skill competency and stronghold in one or more of the following - design, technical, innovation, strategy. And be able to demonstrate the same through their projects. Software proficiency expected in a combination of the following - AutoCAD, Civil3D, REVIT, GIS, MicroStation, Rhino, Adobe Suite, MS Office, AI Automation & Prompt engineering. Willingness & skill to time effectively learn any new or above-mentioned software that may be part of the project requirement. Rewards & Benefits Comprehensive life insurance coverage. Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents. Generous annual leave balance. Flexible and hybrid work solutions. Remote work opportunities outside of country. Company gratuity scheme. Discretionary bonus program. Relocation assistance. Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition. Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.
